name: Book Library
description: Catalogue a shared book collection and collect reader reviews
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read books and reviews; require auth for creating, updating and deleting books and for posting reviews; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Books: any signed-in user may create, update and delete any book; DELETE /api/books/:id removes the book and its reviews permanently

Book validation: title and author are required non-empty strings of at most 255 characters; year, when given, is a whole number from 1000 to the current year; isbn, when given, is at most 20 characters

GET /api/books returns active books, newest first; ?query= matches title or author case-insensitively, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching book
Every book in a response carries review_count and average_rating (the mean rating rounded to one decimal, null without reviews)

Reviews: POST /api/books/:id/reviews stores a rating (whole number 1-5) and an optional comment of at most 1000 characters for the signed-in user; a user reviews a book at most once (a second review answers 409)
Deactivated books (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/books and answer 404 on the public book endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a duplicate review
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the book list and book details read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit, delete and review controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to add books' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Book list: a table with title, author, year and average rating, a search box that filters by title or author, and previous/next paging
Book detail view: the book's fields, its reviews (username, rating, comment, date) and, for signed-in users, a form to post a rating with an optional comment
Add and edit book forms that show the API's validation messages next to the form; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every book, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a book's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active books, newest first, filtered and paged

query.query: Case-insensitive text matched against title and author

api_endpoints.description: Replace a book's fields (title and author required; an omitted year or isbn is cleared)
Delete a book and its reviews
Reviews of a book, newest first
Review a book as the signed-in user

data_models.name: Book
data_models.description: A catalogued book; review_count and average_rating are computed from its reviews

fields.title: string (required, max 255 chars)
fields.author: string (required, max 255 chars)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the book from public endpoints)

data_models.name: Review
data_models.description: One user's rating of one book

fields.book_id: integer (references Book.id; deleted with the book)
fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who wrote it; one review per user and book)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every book with counts
